title: Securities Trading Policy (Policy No: 1.4)

tiers.name: All directors and employees
tiers.description: All directors and employees of the Wesfarmers Group. Subject only to the insider trading prohibitions (dealing, tipping, applying to a share plan while holding inside information) and any Project Restrictions; no clearance, blackout, hedging or financing restrictions apply at this level.

tiers.name: Officers
tiers.description: Directors of Wesfarmers and members of the Wesfarmers Leadership Team. Subject to Annexure B: prior clearance from the Company Secretary for every dealing in Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities, Blackout Periods, and clearance-gated restrictions on short-term dealing, short selling, security interests, margin loans and hedging.

tiers.name: Directors
tiers.description: Directors of Wesfarmers; an Officer subset distinguished by Chairman (or Chair of the Audit and Risk Committee) sign-off on clearance, a wider Associated Party net (any person or entity whose dealing would require ASX disclosure by the director), Corporations Act and Listing Rule notification obligations, a Board Charter minimum shareholding and a letter agreement on notification of trading.

tiers.name: Associated Parties
tiers.description: Immediate family members living with an Officer (or whose investment decisions the Officer controls), any company, trust, managed superannuation fund or other entity controlled by the Officer or such family member, and, for directors only, any person or entity whose dealing would require ASX disclosure by the director (including where the director controls voting or disposal or is entitled to benefit from a contract to call for or deliver Wesfarmers securities).

definitions.hedging_definition: an arrangement (with anyone) if the arrangement would have the effect of limiting the exposure of that director or senior executive to risk relating to an element of that director or senior executive's remuneration that remains subject to restrictions on disposal

windows.end_anchor: one trading day following the announcement of the full-year results in August (close of trading on the following trading day if results are released during or after trading)
one trading day following the announcement of the half-year results in February (close of trading on the following trading day if results are released during or after trading)

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: 'Project Restrictions' may be imposed from time to time on nominated directors and employees due to their knowledge of a potential project or transaction. The policy does not say who imposes them or whether they are confidential; the Company Secretary's clearance confirmation covers whether the dealing is 'subject to any other restriction under this policy'.

rules.detail: Derivative trading is not named as a restricted activity, but 'securities' expressly includes equity swaps, CFDs, futures, hedges and exchange-traded or over-the-counter options, and dealing includes creating a hedge or other financial interest over or in relation to securities. An OTC put or call with a bank is therefore a dealing requiring the full Annexure B 3 clearance process and is barred in Blackout Periods. For an off-market dealing the dealing occurs at settlement, which must fall within two clear trading days of clearance.
rules.evidence: securities includes shares, options, notes, bonds and other debentures, interests in managed investment schemes, trusts and other financial products, and any derivatives of those securities, including equity swaps, contracts for difference, futures, hedges and exchange-traded or over-the-counter options, whether settled by cash or otherwise.

rules.detail: Employees who are not Officers may deal in derivatives over Wesfarmers securities subject only to not holding inside information and any Project Restrictions; no clearance or blackout applies.
rules.evidence: All directors and employees of the Wesfarmers Group are prohibited from: (a) dealing in any securities where the person dealing in the securities has inside information in relation to those securities

rules.detail: The policy restates the Corporations Act prohibition on KMP and their closely related parties limiting exposure to risk relating to remuneration that remains subject to restrictions on disposal, and states that clearance cannot be obtained for such dealings. Applies to Officers who are KMP.
rules.evidence: Clearance cannot be obtained from the Wesfarmers Company Secretary under paragraph 3 of this Annexure B for dealings which are restricted by the Corporations Act.

rules.detail: The Corporations Act restriction as restated applies to any element of remuneration that 'remains subject to restrictions on disposal', which captures vested shares still under a holding lock or disposal restriction under a share plan. No clearance is available.
rules.evidence: from entering into an arrangement (with anyone) if the arrangement would have the effect of limiting the exposure of that director or senior executive to risk relating to an element of that director or senior executive's remuneration that remains subject to restrictions on disposal.

rules.detail: Hedging Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities is prohibited for Officers and Associated Parties unless approval is sought and clearance obtained from the Company Secretary and all Annexure B 3 steps are complied with. Clearance is discretionary and will not be given where the 'front page' test is failed.
rules.evidence: Each Officer and their Associated Parties are prohibited from engaging in the following dealings: ... (e) hedging Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities, unless approval has been sought and clearance obtained from the Wesfarmers Company Secretary, and all steps outlined in paragraph 3 of this Annexure B have been complied with.

rules.detail: Creating a hedge is a dealing, but for non-Officer employees the only constraints are the insider trading prohibition, Project Restrictions and share plan rules. Non-KMP employees are outside the Corporations Act hedging restriction restated in Annexure B 9.
rules.evidence: creating a hedge, security interest, margin loan or other financial interest over or in relation to securities

rules.detail: Monetisation structures are not named. A prepaid forward, funded collar or similar is a dealing (agreeing to sell; creating a financial interest over securities) requiring clearance, and any secured or financial interest component falls within the express Annexure B 9(d) clearance requirement.
rules.evidence: any other transfer or creation of an interest in securities, whether directly, or by arranging for someone else to undertake the dealing on your behalf; and (vii) agreeing or applying to do any of the above.

rules.detail: Short selling by Officers and Associated Parties is prohibited unless approval is sought and clearance obtained from the Company Secretary; it is not an absolute ban.
rules.evidence: (c) entering into instruments or transactions to borrow and sell Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities with the intention of buying Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities back at a later date (short selling)

rules.detail: The short selling restriction is confined to Annexure B (Officers); the general policy is silent for other employees.

Lending securities is not named. Transferring legal ownership even where beneficial ownership does not change is a dealing, so lending shares to a bank (or delivering them to a custodian) requires Officer clearance. Borrowing to sell is caught as short selling under Annexure B 9(c).
rules.evidence: transferring legal ownership of securities, even where beneficial ownership does not change

rules.detail: Contracts for difference are named in the definition of securities, so dealing in a CFD over Wesfarmers securities requires clearance; a short CFD would also fall within the short selling and short-term dealing restrictions of Annexure B 9.
rules.evidence: any derivatives of those securities, including equity swaps, contracts for difference, futures, hedges

rules.detail: Entering into a margin loan in respect of Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities is prohibited for Officers and Associated Parties unless clearance is obtained from the Company Secretary and the Annexure B 3 process is followed. Entering into a margin loan is also a dealing under Annexure A 1(a)(iv).
rules.evidence: (d) creating a security interest or other financial interest, or entering into a margin loan in respect of, Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities

rules.detail: For non-Officer employees a margin loan is a dealing subject only to the insider trading prohibition and any Project Restrictions.
rules.evidence: creating a hedge, security interest, margin loan or other financial interest over or in relation to securities

rules.detail: Creating a security interest over Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities, in any context, requires Company Secretary clearance for Officers and Associated Parties. Creating a security interest is also itself a dealing, so it attracts Blackout Periods and, for off-market dealings, the settle-within-two-trading-days rule.
rules.evidence: (d) creating a security interest or other financial interest, or entering into a margin loan in respect of, Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities

rules.detail: Creating a security interest is a dealing; for non-Officer employees it is restricted only by the insider trading prohibition and Project Restrictions.
rules.evidence: creating a hedge, security interest, margin loan or other financial interest over or in relation to securities

rules.detail: Any financing secured on Wesfarmers securities (security interest, other financial interest or margin loan) is a clearance-gated dealing for Officers, not an outright prohibition. There is no security-state carve-out in the policy, but share plan rules must be complied with for plan shares.
rules.evidence: creating a security interest or other financial interest, or entering into a margin loan in respect of, Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities ... unless approval has been sought and clearance obtained from the Wesfarmers Company Secretary

rules.detail: Acquiring with the intention of disposing within less than three months, or disposing with the intention of buying back within less than three months, is prohibited for Officers and Associated Parties unless clearance is obtained. Disposals within a short period after vesting or issuance under a share plan are carved out.
rules.evidence: (a) acquiring Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities with the intention of disposing of some or all of those securities within a period of less than three months from the date of acquisition (this does not include disposals of Wesfarmers securities within a short period of time after vesting or issuance of those securities under a share plan)

rules.detail: No short-term dealing restriction applies outside Annexure B.

clearance.approver: Wesfarmers Company Secretary, after confirming with at least two members of the disclosure committee
clearance.post_trade_to: Wesfarmers Company Secretary (confirmation that the transaction has occurred plus a copy of the confirmation documentation)
clearance.evidence: await written advice from the Wesfarmers Company Secretary (which may be given by email) confirming that there is no known reason to preclude the dealing ... in the case of: (i) an on-market dealing, order or otherwise authorise the dealing; and (ii) an off-market dealing, settle the dealing, in Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities within two clear trading days of receiving confirmation

clearance.approver: Wesfarmers Company Secretary, after confirming with at least two members of the disclosure committee and the Chairman (or the Chairman of the Audit and Risk Committee for the Chairman and the Chairman's Associated Parties)
clearance.post_trade_to: Wesfarmers Company Secretary (confirmation and documentation under Annexure B 3(e), and notification under the director's letter agreement); ASX under the Corporations Act and Listing Rules
clearance.post_trade_deadline: unspecified in the policy; statutory and Listing Rule deadlines apply
clearance.evidence: the Chairman, where the dealing involves a Wesfarmers director or their Associated Parties, (or with the Chairman of the Audit and Risk Committee where the Chairman of the Board or the Chairman's Associated Parties are seeking to deal in Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities).

It is the responsibility of each director and employee, prior to dealing in securities, to consider carefully whether they possess inside information that may preclude dealing at that time and, if in doubt, should refrain from dealing.

short_term.basis: from acquisition (and from sale or disposal for the buy-back limb)
carve_outs: disposals of Wesfarmers securities within a short period of time after vesting or issuance of those securities under a share plan
any short-term dealing for which approval has been sought and clearance obtained from the Company Secretary
short_term.evidence: acquiring Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities with the intention of disposing of some or all of those securities within a period of less than three months from the date of acquisition

exceptions.evidence: dealings under an offer or invitation made to all or most shareholders or class of shareholders, for example a disposal of Wesfarmers securities arising from the acceptance of an equal access buy-back or an acquisition of Wesfarmers securities under a pro rata issue
a disposal in relation to the acceptance of a takeover offer
the acquisition of Wesfarmers securities under a Wesfarmers share plan, or dividend investment plan, provided that: the director or employee was not in possession of inside information

Where an employee is subject to Project Restrictions, the Wesfarmers Chief Financial Officer may approve an issue of securities to the employee under an employee share plan (rather than acquisition of the securities on-market).

exceptions.approver: Chairman (or Chair of the Audit and Risk Committee for the Chairman) in writing to the Company Secretary, plus Company Secretary written confirmation
exceptions.evidence: the Officer or an Associated Party is facing severe financial hardship, such that a sale of their Wesfarmers securities is the only reasonable option available to resolving the hardship

exceptions.approver: Chairman (or Chair of the Audit and Risk Committee for the Chairman) in writing to the Company Secretary
exceptions.evidence: the Officer or an Associated Party is required by a final court order or enforceable court undertaking to sell or otherwise transfer Wesfarmers securities to a third party

exceptions.approver: Chairman (or Chair of the Audit and Risk Committee for the Chairman) in writing to the Company Secretary
exceptions.evidence: the Officer has identified another exceptional circumstance where the dealing by an Officer or their Associated Parties of their Wesfarmers securities is the only reasonable option available to resolve the circumstance

exceptions.approver: Wesfarmers Company Secretary (Annexure B 3 and 5 process still required)
exceptions.evidence: if the dealing does not involve a change in beneficial ownership, and does not require disclosure to the ASX.

financing_disclosure: Officers: at inception, as part of the clearance request, details of the type of dealing (security interest, margin loan or hedge) and the number of securities involved, to the Wesfarmers Company Secretary, before dealing; and confirmation with a copy of the transaction documentation after completion.

Directors: notification of trading in Wesfarmers securities to the ASX under the Corporations Act and Listing Rules, and to the Company Secretary under the director's letter agreement; the policy does not state deadlines.
financing.minimum_shareholding_requirement: Directors must comply with the Board Charter requirements on holding a minimum number of Wesfarmers securities (Annexure B 8(b)); the policy does not say whether hedged or encumbered shares count towards it.

external_documents: BWP Management Limited Responsible Entity Securities Dealing Policy
Wesfarmers Board Charter (minimum shareholding requirement for directors)
Letter agreement between each director and Wesfarmers relating to notification of trading in Wesfarmers securities
exemption_authority: Wesfarmers Company Secretary grants or refuses clearance at discretion without reasons, after confirming with at least two disclosure committee members (and the Chairman, or the Chair of the Audit and Risk Committee, for directors). Blackout Period relief is limited to sales in exceptional circumstances with the Chairman's (or ARC Chair's) prior written approval and documentary evidence. The CFO may approve share plan issues to Project-Restricted employees. No clearance can be given for dealings restricted by the Corporations Act. Only the Board may amend the policy.
jurisdiction_overlays: Corporations Act restriction on KMP and closely related parties hedging remuneration that remains subject to restrictions on disposal; clearance cannot be given for such dealings

bespoke_clauses.clause: In the case of an on-market trade, the dealing occurs at execution (but not settlement) of the trade. In the case of an off-market trade, the dealing occurs at settlement of the trade. ... in the case of an off-market dealing, settle the dealing, in Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities within two clear trading days of receiving confirmation from the Wesfarmers Company Secretary
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: An OTC collar and secured loan are off-market dealings, so signing, funding and security grant must all settle within two clear trading days of clearance and outside a Blackout Period, which drives the execution timetable with the bank.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Where any approval under this Policy is required for a dealing, approval will not be granted where the dealing would not satisfy the 'front page' test.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Even a policy-compliant collar can be refused if the Company Secretary considers the market would perceive it as an inappropriate use of position, so reputational optics of hedging director exposure are a live gating factor.

bespoke_clauses.clause: the Corporations Act restricts directors and senior executives of the Wesfarmers Group who are classified as 'key management personnel' ... from entering into an arrangement (with anyone) if the arrangement would have the effect of limiting the exposure of that director or senior executive to risk relating to an element of that director or senior executive's remuneration that remains subject to restrictions on disposal. Clearance cannot be obtained ... for dealings which are restricted by the Corporations Act.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The collar may only be written over shares that are both vested and free of any plan disposal restriction; vested shares still subject to a holding lock cannot be collared by KMP and no waiver is available.

bespoke_clauses.clause: clearance can be given or refused at the discretion of the Wesfarmers Company Secretary, without giving reasons; clearance can be withdrawn by the Wesfarmers Company Secretary at any time prior to the order for dealing being lodged or otherwise authorised, if new information comes to light or there is a change in circumstances
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The bank should not price or commit until clearance is in hand, and the transaction can be pulled up to the moment of settlement.

bespoke_clauses.clause: The only exception to the prohibition on dealing during Blackout Periods is a sale of Wesfarmers securities
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Entering, rolling, restriking or granting security under a collar can never occur in a Blackout Period; only a hardship or court-ordered sale, or a no-change-of-beneficial-ownership transfer, can be approved inside a blackout.

bespoke_clauses.clause: in relation to Wesfarmers directors only, any other person or entity where dealing in Wesfarmers securities by that person or entity would require disclosure to the ASX by the Wesfarmers director. This includes where the Wesfarmers director: (i) controls the right to vote or dispose of Wesfarmers securities; or (ii) is entitled to benefit from a contract to call for, or deliver Wesfarmers securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Routing the collar through a trust, company or superannuation fund does not avoid clearance, and the option contracts themselves are the type of interest that brings a vehicle into the director's Associated Party net.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Directors and employees who acquire Wesfarmers securities under a Wesfarmers share plan must also comply with the rules of that plan when dealing in those securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Plan rules (not in the policy) may impose holding locks or hedging bans over vested plan shares that would independently block a collar or security grant.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Additional restrictions in this Annexure B apply to dealings in Wesfarmers and BWP Trust securities
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The clearance regime and Annexure B 9 restrictions extend to BWP Trust units, although the Blackout Periods are expressed to apply only to Wesfarmers securities.

bespoke_clauses.clause: this does not include disposals of Wesfarmers securities within a short period of time after vesting or issuance of those securities under a share plan
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Newly vested shares can be sold or delivered under a collar without offending the three-month short-term rule, so the collar tenor need not be driven by the vesting date.

summary: A funded collar is possible for Wesfarmers directors and Leadership Team members (Officers), but only with prior written clearance from the Company Secretary, who must first confirm with at least two disclosure committee members and, for directors, the Chairman (or the Chair of the Audit and Risk Committee). Hedging, creating a security interest, entering a margin loan and any OTC derivative are each clearance-gated dealings under Annexure B 9 rather than prohibited, and the clearance is discretionary, revocable, subject to the 'front page' test and valid only for two clear trading days within which an off-market dealing must settle. The collar cannot be written over unvested shares or vested shares still subject to disposal restrictions because the policy restates the Corporations Act KMP hedging restriction and states that clearance cannot be given for it; only vested, unrestricted shares qualify, and plan rules must also be satisfied. Entry, security grant, roll and unwind must all fall outside the 20 June and 20 December Blackout Periods and any Project Restriction, since blackout relief is limited to sales in hardship or court-ordered circumstances. Lender enforcement and margin-call sales are not addressed, and directors must also comply with the Board Charter minimum shareholding and their ASX and letter-agreement notification obligations.
